parser_notes: REAL-WORLD Structured-Text routine export (TargetType=Routine) for the same conveyance line as Conveyance_LD.L5X. Parses cleanly (grade A): 1 controller / 1 program / 1 routine, 44 tags, 81 instructions at 100% known coverage, 11 ST blocks with 0% flagged too-complex. Notably carries a user DataType definition CONVEYANCE_STATE (Class=User), so it is a good real ST + UDT example; the connector captures UDT-typed tags flatly but does not resolve the UDT member typing (Phase 2). Pairs with Conveyance_LD.L5X to cover both languages of one real machine.
